name: Galaxy Strike
storyline: In the year 2307, you are the pilot of an assault space craft. You have been sent on a recon mission to the moon to see what it was that was detected. It appears enemy aliens are going to invade. It is up to you to stop them.
summary: Galaxy Strike (also released as "Space Strike") is a scrolling space shooter. Using your mouse or keyboard, you must make your way through the enemy, killing them as you go. The enemy come at you in continuous waves through twenty progressively harder missions. You begin with an impulse gun. As you progress, you can pick up items to upgrade your impulse gun or even upgrade to a more powerful quantum laser or wave gun. You will also pick up secondary weapons like heat seeking missiles, the annihilator cannon or a nuclear bomb.
